spans.s: ग्लप्स ग्लप्स, अस्, अम्, m. n. a branch (?).

ग्लस् ग्लस्, cl. 1. A. ग्लसते, = ग्रस्, to
eat.
ग्लस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, = ग्रस्त, eaten.

ग्लह् ग्लह्, cl. 1. A. ग्लहते, जग्लहे, ग्ल-
हितुम् and ग्लाढुम्, to gamble, play with
dice, win by gambling; (= rt. ग्रह्) to take, re-
ceive, accept.

ग्लह, अस्, m. a dice-player, the stake in playing,
a wager, bet; the prize or object fought for in a
contest, the person aimed at; a die; a dice-box;
cast of the dice, game at dice; gaming, playing
with dice; contention; a chess-man; ग्लहं दिव्,
to play at dice.

ग्लहन, अम्, n., Ved. playing at dice, casting
the dice.
ग्लान ग्लान, ग्लानि, &c. See under rt. ग्लै.

ग्लान, अस्, आ, अम्, wearied, languid, feeble, emaci-
ated, exhausted by fatigue or disease; sick; (अम्),
n. exhaustion, disease.

ग्लपन, अम्, n. the act of wearying, making
tired, exhaustion, relaxation.
ग्लातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who is tired or exhausted.

ग्लानि, इस्, f. unwillingness, displeasure, depression
of mind, exhaustion, fatigue of body, lassitude, lan-
guor; debility; sickness.
ग्लान्य, अम्, n. decrease of strength, languor.

ग्लायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being exhausted, wearied,
languid, faint.

ग्लाव, अस्, m., N. of a man (with the metronymic
Maitreya).
ग्लाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, displeased, averse, inactive.

ग्लास्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, exhausted by fatigue or disease,
languid, wearied; [cf. Lat. lassus.]
